items.title: The Fight Against MPPR Isn't New. And It Isn't Over
items.summary: The APTA warns that Multiple Procedure Payment Reduction (MPPR) policies are resurfacing among commercial payers, requiring continued advocacy to protect physical therapist payment and patient access to medically necessary services.
items.curatedReason: 本文强调，随着商业保险公司再次加速实施多重程序支付削减（MPPR）政策，你必须认识到这不仅会影响物理治疗师的报销，还可能限制患者获得必要服务的机会。积极参与行业倡导，争取更有利的报销政策，对于维护你的执业收入和患者权益至关重要。
items.titleZh: 反对多重程序支付削减 (MPPR) 的斗争并未结束
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会 (APTA) 警告，多重程序支付削减 (MPPR) 政策正在商业支付方中重新出现，需要持续倡导以保护物理治疗师的支付和患者获得医疗必要服务的权利。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article highlights that as commercial payers accelerate the implementation of Multiple Procedure Payment Reduction (MPPR) policies, you must recognize that this not only impacts physical therapist reimbursement but may also limit patient access to necessary services. Active participation in advocacy efforts to secure more favorable reimbursement policies is crucial for protecting your practice revenue and patient rights.

items.title: The Applied Sport Science of Professional Male Basketball: A Narrative Review of Current and Emerging Practices
items.summary: A narrative review outlines current and emerging applied sport science practices in professional male basketball, emphasizing the complex physical, technical, and travel demands, and the need for holistic, individualized approaches to optimize player preparation, performance, health, and recovery.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述为专业男子篮球运动的运动科学实践提供了全面的概述。在为篮球运动员制定训练、表现和康复策略时，你需要一个多层面、个性化的方法，并谨慎利用新兴技术进行监测，确保数据使用得当。
items.titleZh: 职业男子篮球的运动科学应用：当前与新兴实践的叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述概述了职业男子篮球中当前和新兴的运动科学实践，强调了复杂的身体、技术和出行需求，以及需要采用整体、个性化方法来优化运动员的准备、表现、健康和恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This narrative review provides a comprehensive overview of applied sport science practices in professional male basketball. When developing training, performance, and rehabilitation strategies for basketball players, you need a multifaceted, individualized approach and careful utilization of emerging technologies for monitoring, ensuring data is used appropriately.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，可能未采用系统性的文献检索和质量评估方法，因此其结论可能存在选择偏倚和主观性。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, it may not have employed systematic literature search and quality assessment methods, thus its conclusions might be subject to selection bias and subjectivity.

items.title: Factors associated with current KOOS-defined knee status among recreational runners: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 423 recreational runners identified weekly running frequency, full-marathon participation, previous knee or ankle discomfort, and annual running volume of 600–900 km as factors associated with current KOOS-defined knee status, with previous discomfort showing the strongest link.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究识别了休闲跑步者膝关节状态（KOOS 定义）的相关因素。在评估和咨询休闲跑步者时，你应关注他们的每周跑步频率、全马参与情况、既往膝踝不适史和年跑步量，这些因素可能提示膝关节健康风险。
items.titleZh: 休闲跑步者当前 KOOS 定义膝关节状况的相关因素：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 423 名休闲跑步者的横断面研究发现，每周跑步频率、全马参与、既往膝踝不适史和年跑步量 600-900 公里是与当前 KOOS 定义膝关节状况相关的因素，其中既往不适关联性最强。
items.curatedReasonEn: For recreational runners, a history of knee or ankle discomfort is the most significant red flag when assessing knee health, more so than running frequency, marathon participation, or annual running volume (600-900 km). This suggests that in running injury prevention, prioritizing patient history over simple training metrics is prudent.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法确立因果关系；研究结果依赖于问卷数据，可能存在回忆偏差； nomogram 仍需前瞻性评估和外部验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, so it cannot establish causality; results rely on questionnaire data, which may have recall bias; and the nomogram requires prospective evaluation and external validation.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Smaller Cortical Responses to Balance Perturbations in Parkinson's Disease with Freezing of Gait
items.summary: A study found that Parkinson's disease patients with freezing of gait (FoG) had smaller cortical N1 amplitudes than those without FoG and older adults during backward support-surface translations, suggesting altered perturbation-evoked cortical activity and potentially reflecting altered supplementary motor area function.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，步态冻结（FoG）的帕金森病患者对平衡扰动的皮层反应较小，这可能是辅助运动区功能改变的体现。这些发现可为 FoG 的早期识别和干预提供潜在的神经生理标志物。
items.titleZh: 步态冻结型帕金森病患者对平衡扰动的皮层反应较小
items.summaryZh: 一项研究发现，在向后支撑面平移过程中，步态冻结（FoG）型帕金森病患者的皮层 N1 波幅小于非 FoG 型帕金森病患者和老年人，这提示扰动诱发的皮层活动发生改变，可能反映了辅助运动区功能的改变。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that Parkinson's disease patients with Freezing of Gait (FoG) exhibit smaller cortical responses to balance perturbations, potentially reflecting altered supplementary motor area function. These findings could offer a neurophysiological marker for early FoG identification and intervention.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且仅限于单一中心，可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size and is limited to a single center, which may restrict the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Effectiveness of a Structured Post-Platelet Rich Plasma Rehabilitation Approach on Pain and Function in Subacromial Pain Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial of 54 SAPS patients found that adding a structured post-PRP rehabilitation approach to conventional physiotherapy significantly improved pain (VAS: 2.92 ± 1.14 vs 7.96 ± 0.75; SF-MPQ: 10.07 ± 3.33 vs 19.37 ± 2.35, p < 0.001) and shoulder function compared to conventional physiotherapy alone over 21 days.
items.curatedReason: 有结构化的 PRP 术后康复方案，可能在短期内进一步改善肩峰撞击综合征患者的疼痛、肌力、活动度和肩关节功能。将此作为联合疗法的考量，但记住尚无长期随访数据。
items.titleZh: 结构化富血小板血浆术后康复方案对肩峰下疼痛综合征患者疼痛和功能的影响：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 54 例肩峰下疼痛综合征 (SAPS) 患者的随机对照试验发现，在传统物理治疗基础上增加结构化富血小板血浆 (PRP) 术后康复方案，在 21 天内显著改善了患者的疼痛（VAS：从 9.00 ± 0.67 降至 2.92 ± 1.14，对照组从 9.11 ± 0.64 降至 7.96 ± 0.75；SF-MPQ：从 27.07 ± 4.41 降至 10.07 ± 3.33，对照组从 21.33 ± 2.46 降至 19.37 ± 2.35；p < 0.001）和肩关节功能。
items.curatedReasonEn: A structured post-PRP rehabilitation approach may provide additional short-term improvements in pain, muscle strength, range of motion, and shoulder function in SAPS patients. Consider this as part of a combined therapy, but note the lack of long-term follow-up data.
items.limitation: 研究随访时间短，未评估长期效果。
items.limitationEn: The study had a short follow-up period and did not assess long-term effects.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Next-generation control strategies for lower-extremity exoskeletons: State-of-the-art, limitations, and future directions.
items.summary: This review summarizes current and emerging control strategies for lower-extremity exoskeletons in gait rehabilitation, highlighting their limitations (e.g., unintuitive interfaces, poor adaptation to varying conditions) and exploring advances in user intent detection, such as brain-computer interfaces and novel biosignals.
items.curatedReason: 目前下肢外骨骼在步态康复中的普及，主要受限于其控制策略不够直观、难以适应复杂环境。这份综述系统地指出了现有技术瓶颈，并展望了脑机接口等新兴用户意图检测技术，这将是未来实现外骨骼广泛应用和个性化康复的关键。
items.titleZh: 下肢外骨骼的下一代控制策略：现状、局限性与未来方向。
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述总结了步态康复中下肢外骨骼的当前和新兴控制策略，强调了其局限性（例如，不直观的界面，对不同条件适应性差），并探讨了用户意图检测的进展，如脑机接口和新型生物信号。
items.curatedReasonEn: The widespread adoption of lower-extremity exoskeletons in gait rehabilitation is primarily hampered by unintuitive control strategies and poor adaptation to varying conditions. This review systematically identifies current technical bottlenecks and anticipates emerging user intent detection technologies, such as brain-computer interfaces, which will be crucial for realizing widespread exoskeleton adoption and personalized rehabilitation in the future.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Low-frequency deep brain stimulation promotes long-term orofacial motor recovery after traumatic brain injury: A case study
items.summary: A case study showed that low-frequency continuous deep brain stimulation (55 Hz) of the motor thalamus in a patient with severe diffuse axonal injury and chronic dysarthria/dysphagia led to progressive recovery of facial symmetry, resolution of laryngeal penetration, and marked improvements in respiratory/phonatory control and speech intelligibility over 3 years.
items.curatedReason: 低频脑深部电刺激（DBS）可能对创伤性脑损伤 (TBI) 后的口面部运动功能恢复有长期治疗潜力。尽管是单病例研究，但这种持续性改善的观察，提示 DBS 作为辅助干预手段，可能扩展 TBI 患者的功能恢复窗口。
items.titleZh: 低频脑深部电刺激促进创伤性脑损伤后口面部运动功能的长期恢复：一项病例研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项病例研究显示，一名患有严重弥漫性轴索损伤和慢性构音障碍/吞咽困难的患者，在接受运动丘脑低频持续脑深部电刺激（55 Hz）后，其面部对称性逐渐恢复，喉部穿透得以解决，呼吸/发声控制和言语清晰度在三年内显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Low-frequency deep brain stimulation (DBS) may have long-term therapeutic potential for orofacial motor recovery after traumatic brain injury (TBI). Although a single-case study, this observation of sustained improvement suggests that DBS, as an adjunctive intervention, could extend the window of functional recovery for TBI patients.
items.limitation: 单病例研究，结果外推性极低，需要大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: Single-case study, results have extremely low generalizability, requiring validation in larger studies.

items.title: Patient experiences with a prescription-based digital health application (DiGA) for knee disorders: a qualitative study in german orthopaedic care.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 10 German patients with knee disorders prescribed a DiGA found general acceptance, valuing its flexibility, location independence, and role in bridging physiotherapy gaps, especially for prehabilitation. Challenges included limited personalization and motivational benefits without professional guidance.
items.curatedReason: 数字健康应用程序 (DiGA) 被患者视为骨科护理中物理治疗的有效补充，尤其在术前康复和维持护理方面。了解其在德国医疗体系下的优势与局限，有助于你评估类似技术在自身执业中的应用潜力。
items.titleZh: 德国骨科护理中，膝关节疾病患者使用处方数字健康应用程序 (DiGA) 的经验：一项定性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 10 名被处方数字健康应用程序 (DiGA) 的德国膝关节疾病患者进行的定性研究发现，患者普遍接受并重视其灵活性、地域独立性以及在弥补物理治疗服务差距方面的作用，尤其在术前康复中。挑战包括个性化不足和缺乏专业指导时的激励效果有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: Digital health applications (DiGAs) are perceived by patients as a valuable complement to physiotherapy in orthopedic care, particularly for prehabilitation and continuity of care. Understanding its strengths and limitations in the German healthcare system can help you assess the potential for similar technologies in your own practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量小，且观察期短，未评估长期依从性、临床疗效和安全性。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size and short observation period, not assessing long-term adherence, clinical effectiveness, or safety.

items.title: Benefits and limitations of robotic gait exoskeletons in functional rehabilitation of children with cerebral palsy: an umbrella review.
items.summary: An umbrella review on robotic gait exoskeletons for children with cerebral palsy found that RAGT improves overall motor function, particularly GMFM dimensions D and E, but has limited and inconsistent effects on spatiotemporal gait parameters, and does not consistently outperform treadmill training or conventional physiotherapy.
items.curatedReason: 机器人辅助步态训练 (RAGT) 在改善脑瘫儿童的粗大运动功能方面有一定作用，尤其在 GMFM 量表 D 和 E 维度上，但对时空步态参数的改善不一致。将其作为常规康复的补充手段，并明确其适用范围。
items.titleZh: 机器人步态外骨骼在脑瘫儿童功能康复中的益处和局限性：一项伞形综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项关于脑瘫儿童机器人步态外骨骼的伞形综述发现，机器人辅助步态训练 (RAGT) 可改善总体运动功能，尤其是粗大运动功能测量系统 (GMFM) D 和 E 维度，但对时空步态参数的影响有限且不一致，并且在步态相关结局方面并不持续优于跑步机训练或传统物理治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: Robot-Assisted Gait Training (RAGT) can improve gross motor function in children with cerebral palsy, especially in GMFM dimensions D and E, but improvements in spatiotemporal gait parameters are inconsistent. Consider it as a complementary intervention to conventional rehabilitation, with clear application boundaries.
items.limitation: 这是一项伞形综述，依赖于纳入研究的异质性，且未报告除 GMFM-88 和时空步态参数外的其他结局指标。
items.limitationEn: This is an umbrella review, dependent on the heterogeneity of included studies, and did not report outcomes other than GMFM-88 and spatiotemporal gait parameters.

items.title: Everything You Need to Know About the 2027 Final Rule
items.summary: WebPT's blog post summarizes key information regarding the 2027 Final Rule, covering changes relevant to physical therapy practice and reimbursement.
items.curatedReason: WebPT 的这篇博文为你梳理了 2027 年最终规则的要点，涵盖了对 PT 执业和报销的重要变化。尽管这只是一个概述，但它能让你快速掌握 Medicare 费率、报销政策等关键信息，助你提前规划应对。
items.titleZh: 2026 年 11 月 5 日：关于 2027 年最终规则你需要知道的一切
items.summaryZh: WebPT 的博文总结了 2027 年最终规则的关键信息，涵盖了与物理治疗执业和报销相关的变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This WebPT blog post summarizes the key points of the 2027 Final Rule. While specific details require consulting official documents, this overview is crucial for understanding changes in Medicare rates, reimbursement policies, and other key factors affecting PT practice, helping you plan your strategies in advance.

items.title: CMS Final Rule Strengthens Supports Lasting Drug Savings
items.summary: CMS has released a final rule to strengthen and support lasting drug savings, focusing on the Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program and the Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit Program.
items.curatedReason: CMS 发布了旨在巩固药物定价谈判和处方药福利计划的最终规则。这对 PT 报销和执业没有直接影响，但作为美国医疗系统关键部分的成本控制机制，值得你关注宏观背景。不过这并非 PT 执业的直接变化点。
items.titleZh: CMS 最终规则加强并支持持久的药物节约
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了一项最终规则，旨在加强并支持持久的药物节约，重点关注医疗保险药物价格谈判计划和医疗保险处方药福利计划。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released a final rule concerning drug price negotiation and prescription drug benefits. While this doesn't directly impact your PT reimbursement or daily practice, understanding these macro policy shifts in healthcare cost control can help you contextualize the broader industry landscape.

items.title: Calendar Year (CY) 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule Final Rule
items.summary: CMS issued the Calendar Year (CY) 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule final rule, effective Jan. 1, 2027, finalizing a projected decrease in the qualifying APM conversion factor by $0.62 (-1.83%) to $32.95 and the non-qualifying APM conversion factor by $0.77 (-2.31%) to $32.63, driven by a statutory -2.50% reduction from CY 2026.
items.curatedReason: CMS 发布的 2027 年医师收费标准最终规则，明确了 Medicare 物理治疗师的报销费率将继续面临整体下降（QP 下降 1.83%，非 QP 下降 2.31%）。物理治疗执业者必须审视并调整运营模式，以应对这些持续的财务压力。
items.titleZh: 2027 日历年（CY）Medicare 医师收费标准最终规则
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了2027日历年（CY）Medicare医师收费标准最终规则，自2027年1月1日起生效，最终确定合格APM转换系数预计将减少0.62美元（-1.83%）至32.95美元，非合格APM转换系数将减少0.77美元（-2.31%）至32.63美元，主要原因是法定从2026日历年减少2.50%。
items.curatedReasonEn: The CMS CY 2027 Physician Fee Schedule final rule clarifies that Medicare reimbursement rates for physical therapists will continue to face overall decreases (1.83% for QPs, 2.31% for non-QPs). Physical therapy practitioners must review and adjust their operational models to address these ongoing financial pressures.

items.title: Development and psychometric evaluation of the Severity of Myalgic Encephalomyelitis Scale (SoMES) and the Myalgic Encephalomyelitis Occupational Status Scale (MEOSS)
items.summary: The Severity of Myalgic Encephalomyelitis Scale (SoMES) and the Myalgic Encephalomyelitis Occupational Status Scale (MEOSS) were developed and found to be valid, reliable, and sensitive assessments of disease severity and occupational status in 995 adults with ME/CFS, demonstrating moderate-good criterion-related validity (SoMES r=0.663, MEOSS r=0.472) and excellent test-retest reliability for MEOSS (k=0.76).
items.curatedReason: 新量表 SoMES 和 MEOSS 为肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征的疾病严重程度和职业状态评估提供了有效、可靠且敏感的工具，有助于临床医生更客观地跟踪患者的疾病进展和康复需求。
items.titleZh: 肌痛性脑脊髓炎严重程度量表（SoMES）和肌痛性脑脊髓炎职业状态量表（MEOSS）的开发与心理测量学评估
items.summaryZh: 肌痛性脑脊髓炎严重程度量表（SoMES）和肌痛性脑脊髓炎职业状态量表（MEOSS）已开发完成，并在995名肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征成人患者中被证实为疾病严重程度和职业状态的有效、可靠且敏感的评估工具，显示出中度至良好的效标关联效度（SoMES r=0.663, MEOSS r=0.472）和MEOSS优秀的重测信度（k=0.76）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The new SoMES and MEOSS scales provide valid, reliable, and sensitive tools for assessing disease severity and occupational status in Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome, helping clinicians objectively track patient progression and rehabilitation needs.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的横断面心理测量学研究，需要通过更多前瞻性研究来验证其在不同人群和长期随访中的表现。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary cross-sectional psychometric study, requiring further prospective research to validate its performance in diverse populations and long-term follow-up.

items.title: Interactive Gardening Intervention for Preschoolers With Developmental Delays: A Family-Centered Feasibility Study.
items.summary: A nonrandomized controlled pilot study (n=60 caregiver-child dyads) found a 6-week interactive gardening intervention improved social functioning (mean change, 3.34 ± 9.47; p = .007) within the intervention group of preschoolers with developmental delays, compared to controls (1.72 ± 13.56; p = .269). No significant changes were seen in sensory integration or caregiver outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步观察研究提示，为期6周的家庭互动式园艺活动可能改善发育迟缓学龄前儿童的社交功能。虽然是小样本非随机研究，但为强调家庭参与和社交互动的早期康复提供了一个可尝试的补充干预思路。
items.titleZh: 互动式园艺干预对发育迟缓学龄前儿童的影响：一项以家庭为中心的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项非随机对照试点研究（n=60对照顾者-儿童配对）发现，为期6周的互动式园艺干预改善了发育迟缓学龄前儿童干预组内的社交功能（平均变化3.34 ± 9.47；p = .007），而对照组无显著改善（1.72 ± 13.56；p = .269）。感官整合或照顾者相关结局未见显著变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary observational study suggests that a 6-week home-based interactive gardening intervention might improve social functioning in preschoolers with developmental delays. While a small, non-randomized study, it offers a potential supplementary intervention idea for early rehabilitation emphasizing family involvement and social interaction.
items.limitation: 本研究为非随机对照的试点研究，样本量相对较小，且社交功能改善仅为组内显著，缺乏对感官整合和照护者结局的显著影响。
items.limitationEn: This is a nonrandomized controlled pilot study with a relatively small sample size, showing only within-group significant improvement in social functioning and lacking significant effects on sensory integration and caregiver outcomes.

items.title: Healthcare professionals' perceptions and experiences of promoting physical activity in persons with multiple sclerosis: a systematic review of qualitative evidence.
items.summary: A systematic review of eight studies found that improving physical activity promotion in MS care requires MS-specific education and training for healthcare professionals, practical resources such as patient education materials and referral pathways, and stronger cross-sector coordination to sustain consistent practice.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述强调，提高MS患者的运动促进效果，需要针对性的教育培训、患者教育材料、转诊路径以及跨部门协作。这对PT设计MS康复项目有直接的指导意义，特别是针对如何提升患者依从性和促进运动参与。
items.titleZh: 医护人员对多发性硬化症患者运动促进的看法和经验：一项定性证据系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含8项研究的系统综述发现，为改善多发性硬化症患者的运动促进，需加强医护人员的MS特异性教育与培训、提供患者教育材料和转诊路径等实用资源，并强化跨部门协调以维持持续实践。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights that effective physical activity promotion in MS patients requires targeted education, patient materials, referral pathways, and cross-sector coordination. This offers direct guidance for PTs in designing MS rehabilitation programs, particularly for improving patient adherence and exercise participation.
items.limitation: 纳入研究均为定性证据，其结果受限于医疗专业人员的感知和经验，不直接评估干预措施的临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: The included studies are qualitative, with results limited by healthcare professionals' perceptions and experiences, and do not directly evaluate the clinical efficacy of interventions.

items.title: Efficacy of Manual Physiotherapy Techniques for Improving Cervical Range of Motion in Infants With Congenital Muscular Torticollis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of five RCTs (n=143 infants) found a statistically significant pooled effect (Cohen's d = 0.90, 95% CI: 0.54 to 1.27, p < 0.001) in favor of manual physiotherapy techniques for improving cervical ROM in infants with congenital muscular torticollis, indicating a large overall effect.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析确证了手法物理治疗技术在改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿颈椎活动度方面的临床意义。手法治疗应该作为你早期干预这些患儿的一线方案，但同时要注意研究的局限性，期待更多长期数据。
items.titleZh: 手法物理治疗技术在改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿颈椎活动度方面的疗效：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对五项随机对照试验（n=143 名婴儿）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，手法物理治疗技术在改善先天性肌性斜颈婴儿颈椎活动度方面具有统计学上显著的汇总效应（Cohen's d = 0.90, 95% CI: 0.54 至 1.27, p < 0.001），表明总体效果显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis (5 RCTs, 143 infants) strongly confirms that manual physiotherapy significantly improves cervical ROM in infants with congenital muscular torticollis (Cohen's d = 0.90). Therefore, manual therapy should be your first-line intervention for these infants. However, note the relatively small sample sizes of included studies and anticipate more long-term efficacy data.
items.limitation: 本系统综述和荟萃分析纳入的研究数量较少（5 项 RCT），干预方案存在差异，且缺乏长期随访数据，限制了结论的普遍性和持久性。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis included a small number of studies (5 RCTs), showed variability in intervention protocols, and lacked long-term follow-up data, limiting the generalizability and durability of the conclusions.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Feasibility, Safety, and Preliminary Effect Estimates of an Ultrasound-Informed Hybrid Joint-Sparing Rehabilitation Strategy in Patients With Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Prospective Non-Randomized Proof-of-Concept Study.
items.summary: A prospective non-randomized proof-of-concept study (n=60) found a 12-week ultrasound-informed hybrid rehabilitation protocol was feasible and safe in rheumatoid arthritis, showing greater pain reduction (ΔVAS: -2.88 ± 0.84 vs. -0.60 ± 0.20 cm; p < 0.001; Cohen's d = 3.74) compared to education, though effects may be overestimated.
items.curatedReason: 这项概念验证研究表明，超声引导的混合康复方案在类风湿关节炎患者中是可行且安全的，并能显著减轻疼痛，但其非随机设计和结果的过高估计需要更严谨的 RCT 验证。
items.titleZh: 超声引导下混合式关节保护康复策略治疗类风湿关节炎患者的可行性、安全性和初步疗效评估：一项前瞻性非随机概念验证研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性非随机概念验证研究（n=60）发现，为期 12 周的超声引导混合康复方案对类风湿关节炎患者可行且安全，并显示出比单纯教育更大的疼痛缓解（ΔVAS：-2.88 ± 0.84 vs. -0.60 ± 0.20 cm；p < 0.001；Cohen's d = 3.74），尽管效果可能被高估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This proof-of-concept study shows an ultrasound-informed hybrid rehabilitation protocol is feasible, safe, and significantly reduces pain in RA patients. However, its non-randomized design and likely overestimated effect size call for more rigorous RCT validation.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本、单中心、非随机的概念验证研究，且没有预设可行性标准，可能高估了疼痛缓解效果，且超声指导方案的益处未得到充分证明。
items.limitationEn: This is a small, single-center, non-randomized proof-of-concept study without prespecified feasibility criteria, likely overestimating pain reduction, and the benefit of ultrasound-informed prescription is not fully substantiated.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Neurorehabilitation as an Opportunity for Structured Post-Stroke Lipid Management: A Narrative Review.
items.summary: A narrative review highlights neurorehabilitation as an opportunity for structured post-stroke lipid management, summarizing evidence for intensive LDL-C reduction in secondary stroke prevention and suggesting integration of medication titration, adherence monitoring, and risk stratification into rehabilitation settings.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提示，卒中后神经康复可作为结构化脂质管理的机会，强调了密集降脂治疗在二级预防中的重要性，并指出康复环境能促进药物滴定和依从性监测，你可以考虑在你的康复计划中更积极地整合心血管风险管理。
items.titleZh: 神经康复作为卒中后结构化脂质管理的机会：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述强调神经康复是卒中后结构化脂质管理的一个机会，总结了强化低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-C）降低在卒中二级预防中的证据，并建议将药物滴定、依从性监测和风险分层整合到康复环境中。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review suggests that neurorehabilitation offers an opportunity for structured post-stroke lipid management, highlighting the importance of intensive lipid-lowering therapy in secondary prevention. It points out how the rehabilitation setting can facilitate medication titration and adherence monitoring, prompting you to consider more active integration of cardiovascular risk management into your rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，缺乏系统性证据综合，且未包含直接在康复环境中进行药物干预的随机对照试验。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, lacking systematic evidence synthesis, and does not include randomized controlled trials directly involving medication interventions within rehabilitation settings.

items.title: Machine Learning Prediction of Independent Walking 8 Weeks After Rehabilitation in Patients With Stroke: A Retrospective Study.
items.summary: A retrospective study (n=169) compared machine learning models for predicting independent walking 8 weeks post-stroke. The neural network had the highest AUC (0.884; 95% CI, 0.832-0.937) and average precision (0.771), with BBS and SEP severity as leading predictors, though no model was statistically superior after adjustment.
items.curatedReason: 基于回顾性数据，神经网络模型在预测卒中后 8 周独立行走能力方面表现最好，AUC 达 0.884。这提示机器学习在早期预判中有潜力，但鉴于没有模型在统计学上显著优于其他模型，且是回顾性研究，在临床实践中应用前，仍需大规模前瞻性验证。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者康复 8 周后独立行走能力的机器学习预测：一项回顾性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性研究（n=169）比较了机器学习模型在预测卒中患者 8 周后独立行走能力方面的表现。神经网络模型具有最高的 AUC（0.884；95% CI，0.832-0.937）和平均精度（0.771），其中 Biodex 平衡系统和体感诱发电位严重程度是主要预测因子，但经过调整后没有模型在统计学上显示出显著优势。
items.curatedReasonEn: A neural network model performed best in predicting independent walking 8 weeks post-stroke, achieving an AUC of 0.884 based on retrospective data. This suggests potential for machine learning in early prognosis, but given no model was statistically superior and it was a retrospective study, large-scale prospective validation is needed before clinical implementation.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性研究，缺乏外部验证，可能存在选择偏倚，且预测结果的临床实施仍需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center retrospective study lacking external validation, potentially subject to selection bias, and clinical implementation of predictive results requires further validation.

items.title: Beyond Reconstruction: Return to Olympic Medal Performance Following Morphology-Informed and Criterion-Based Nonoperative Management of a Femoral-Sided Sherman Type II ACL Injury - A Case Report.
items.summary: A case report describes an elite field hockey player with a femoral-sided Sherman Type II ACL injury who, through morphology-informed nonoperative management and criterion-based rehabilitation, returned to Olympic silver-medal performance 200 days post-injury, challenging the necessity of reconstruction for similar elite athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这个病例报告展示了精英运动员在股骨侧 II 型 ACL 损伤后，通过形态学指导的非手术管理和基于标准的康复，成功重返奥运水平比赛。这挑战了传统观念，提示在选定患者中，非手术方案结合严格的康复和功能评估可能成为重建术的有效替代。
items.titleZh: 超越重建：股骨侧 Sherman II 型 ACL 损伤后通过形态学指导和基于标准的非手术管理重返奥运奖牌水平表现——病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一项病例报告描述了一名精英曲棍球运动员在股骨侧 Sherman II 型 ACL 损伤后，通过形态学指导的非手术管理和基于标准的康复，在伤后 200 天重返奥运并获得银牌，挑战了类似精英运动员需要重建的传统观念。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report demonstrates an elite athlete's successful return to Olympic-level competition after a femoral-sided Sherman Type II ACL injury, managed non-operatively with morphology-informed and criterion-based rehabilitation. This challenges conventional wisdom, suggesting that for selected patients, non-operative approaches with rigorous rehabilitation and functional assessment could be a viable alternative to reconstruction.
items.limitation: 这是一个单病例报告，证据级别低，结果不具备广泛推广性，且缺乏对照组验证非手术方案的有效性。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report with a low level of evidence, and its findings are not broadly generalizable; it also lacks a control group to validate the efficacy of the non-operative approach.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Female Team-Sport Athletes’ Physical Fitness and Jump Performance Kinematics After Plyometric Jump Training: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 31 articles (n=609) found that plyometric jump training (PJT) significantly improved countermovement jump height (ES = 0.550, p < 0.001), drop jump reactive strength index (ES = 0.926, p = 0.001), linear sprint speed, and agility sprint speed in adult female team-sport athletes, with longer interventions (≥ 8 weeks) showing greater benefits.
items.curatedReason: 请注意，跳深训练（PJT）确实能显著提升成年女子团队运动员的跳跃高度（ES = 0.550）、下落跳反应强度指数（ES = 0.926）、冲刺速度和敏捷性。为获得更佳效果，你的 PJT 干预方案至少要持续 8 周。这是提高女性运动员爆发力和运动表现的可靠策略。
items.titleZh: 跳深训练后女子团队运动员的体能和跳跃表现运动学：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 31 篇文章（n=609）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，跳深训练（PJT）显著改善了成年女子团队运动员的下蹲跳高度（ES = 0.550, p < 0.001）、跳深反应强度指数（ES = 0.926, p = 0.001）、直线冲刺速度和敏捷性冲刺速度，其中持续时间更长（≥ 8 周）的干预显示出更大的益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: Be aware that plyometric jump training (PJT) significantly boosts countermovement jump height (ES = 0.550), drop jump reactive strength index (ES = 0.926), linear sprint speed, and agility sprint speed in adult female team-sport athletes. For superior results, ensure your PJT interventions last at least 8 weeks. This is a reliable strategy for enhancing explosive power and athletic performance in female athletes.
items.limitation: 证据确定性被评估为低至中等，部分分析存在中度异质性（I² ≤ 73.1%）。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence was assessed as low to moderate, with moderate heterogeneity (I² ≤ 73.1%) in some analyses.

items.title: Feasibility of an interprofessional rehabilitation program (IPRehab-LBP) for people with chronic low back pain in Ethiopia: an open-label pilot randomized controlled trial with an embedded process evaluation
items.summary: An open-label pilot RCT (n=40) for chronic low back pain in Ethiopia found an interprofessional rehabilitation program (IPRehab-LBP) feasible and acceptable, with high retention (92.5% post-intervention) and outcome-measure completion (>99%), and exploratory clinical outcomes favoring IPRehab-LBP (baseline-adjusted RMDQ mean difference, − 6.29; 95% CI, − 9.69 to − 2.89).
items.curatedReason: 这项针对慢性腰痛（CLBP）的试点 RCT 证实了跨专业康复计划（IPRehab-LBP）在埃塞俄比亚的可行性和可接受性。结果支持将该计划推进到一项更全面的有效性-实施混合试验，为低资源地区 CLBP 管理提供了重要方向。
items.titleZh: 埃塞俄比亚慢性腰痛患者跨专业康复计划（IPRehab-LBP）的可行性：一项开放标签的试点随机对照试验及内嵌过程评估
items.summaryZh: 一项在埃塞俄比亚进行的针对慢性腰痛的开放标签试点随机对照试验（n=40）发现，跨专业康复计划（IPRehab-LBP）具有可行性和可接受性，干预后留存率高（92.5%），结局测量完成率超过 99%。探索性临床结局显示 IPRehab-LBP 组优于常规护理组（基线调整后的 RMDQ 平均差异为 − 6.29；95% CI, − 9.69 至 − 2.89）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT for chronic low back pain (CLBP) confirms the feasibility and acceptability of an interprofessional rehabilitation program (IPRehab-LBP) in Ethiopia. The findings support advancing this program to a more comprehensive hybrid effectiveness-implementation trial, offering an important direction for CLBP management in low-resource settings.
items.limitation: 研究未达到预设的招募率和单次治疗时长要求，且为单中心试点研究。
items.limitationEn: The study did not meet its prespecified recruitment rate and session duration criteria, and it was a single-center pilot study.

items.title: Discriminant and Prognostic Validity of the Multimodal Exertional Test (MET) for Athletes with Concussion
items.summary: This study (n=115 athletes) found that the Multimodal Exertional Test (MET) demonstrated discriminant validity by eliciting greater symptom provocation in concussed athletes compared to healthy athletes. Passing the MET at week 1 post-injury was associated with a 20.6 days faster time to medical clearance (90% CrI = 4.9–36.8 days, pprob > 0 = 97.7%), supporting its prognostic utility.
items.curatedReason: 本研究确立了多模式劳力测试（MET）在评估脑震荡运动员中的判别和预后效度。如果患者能在伤后第一周通过 MET，其医疗清除时间平均缩短 20.6 天，这为您早期管理和重返运动决策提供了有价值的工具。
items.titleZh: 脑震荡运动员多模式劳力测试（MET）的判别和预后效度
items.summaryZh: 这项研究（n=115 名运动员）发现，多模式劳力测试（MET）通过在脑震荡运动员中引发更明显的症状，展现出良好的判别效度。在受伤后第一周通过 MET 与医疗清除时间平均快 20.6 天相关（90% CrI = 4.9–36.8 天，pprob > 0 = 97.7%），支持其预后效用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study establishes the discriminant and prognostic validity of the Multimodal Exertional Test (MET) in concussed athletes. If patients can pass the MET within the first week post-injury, their medical clearance time is, on average, 20.6 days shorter, providing you with a valuable tool for early management and return-to-sport decisions.
items.limitation: 研究为单中心设计，且受试者为大学校际运动员，可能限制结果向其他人群的外推。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted at a single academic institution with interuniversity athletes, potentially limiting generalizability to other populations.

items.title: Post-discharge home-based rehabilitation for frail older adults a scoping review of environmental support strategies for functional recovery and aging-in-place
items.summary: A scoping review of 10 studies found that post-discharge home-based rehabilitation for frail older adults primarily involves home rehabilitation, complemented by caregiver support and service coordination. Environmental support components varied, including home assessment, modification, and assistive devices, but their individual contributions remain unclear due to their multicomponent delivery.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述综合了体弱老年人出院后居家康复的环境支持策略，强调居家康复是核心，并辅以照护者支持和服务协调。它揭示了环境支持策略组合的多样性，并呼吁未来研究标准化衰弱定义和结局指标，以更好地评估个体策略的有效性。
items.titleZh: 体弱老年人出院后居家康复的环境支持策略：一项功能康复和居家养老的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 10 项研究进行的范围综述发现，体弱老年人出院后的居家康复主要包括居家康复、照护者支持和服务协调。环境支持策略的组成多种多样，包括居家评估、改造和辅助设备，但由于其多组件的实施方式，各策略的个体贡献尚不明确。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review synthesizes environmental support strategies for post-discharge home-based rehabilitation in frail older adults, emphasizing home rehabilitation as core, supplemented by caregiver support and service coordination. It reveals the diversity in environmental support combinations and calls for future research to standardize frailty definitions and outcome measures to better evaluate the effectiveness of individual strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一篇范围综述，未对纳入研究进行正式的质量评估。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review and did not undertake a formal critical appraisal of study quality.

items.title: Midlife mobility assessment from the pocket: agreement and consistency between smartphone placement configurations
items.summary: A study on 46 adults (40-64 years) found strong correlations (rs=0.83-0.93 for balance, r=0.996 for STS repetition count) and good-to-excellent consistency between front-pocket/thigh and lower-back smartphone placements for static balance, sit-to-stand, and Timed Up and Go tests, supporting simplified, potentially unsupervised mobility monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 智能手机放入口袋/大腿位置与标准腰部位置进行平衡、坐站转换和 TUG 测试时，其移动性评估结果表现出良好的一致性。这意味着临床中可以更灵活地使用患者自带的智能手机进行初步的移动性筛查，特别是对于中老年人群，有望简化远程监测流程。
items.titleZh: 智能手机放置位置对中老年人移动性评估一致性的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对 46 名中老年人（40-64 岁）的研究发现，智能手机放置在前口袋/大腿位置与标准腰部位置进行静态平衡、坐站转换和 TUG 测试时，其移动性评估结果（如平衡、STS 重复次数 r=0.996）具有很强相关性（rs=0.83-0.93）和良好到优秀的一致性，支持简化且可能无需监督的移动性监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: Smartphone placement in the pocket/thigh shows good agreement with standard lower-back placement for mobility assessments (balance, STS, TUG). This allows for more flexible use of personal smartphones in clinical settings for initial mobility screening, particularly in midlife adults, potentially simplifying remote monitoring protocols.
items.limitation: 部分移动性参数在不同放置位置之间存在绝对值差异，提示在量化评估时仍需注意校准或进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: Some mobility parameters showed absolute value differences between placements, suggesting the need for calibration or further validation in quantitative assessments.

items.title: Normalization of Peak Torque in Adolescent Athletes: Which Method and What Body Parameters to Use?
items.summary: This study investigated the optimal normalization method and body parameters for peak torque assessment in adolescent athletes to improve strength measurement accuracy.
items.curatedReason: 确定在青少年运动员中标准化峰值扭矩的最佳方法，有助于你更准确地评估肌肉力量和功能，指导力量训练方案的设计和康复进展的监测。
items.titleZh: 青少年运动员峰值扭矩的标准化：应采用哪种方法和身体参数？
items.summaryZh: 本研究探讨了青少年运动员峰值扭矩评估的最佳标准化方法和身体参数，以提高力量测量的准确性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Identifying the optimal method for normalizing peak torque in adolescent athletes helps you more accurately assess muscle strength and function, guiding the design of strength training programs and monitoring rehabilitation progress.
items.limitation: 研究可能未涵盖所有潜在的身体参数和标准化方法，且青少年运动员的样本量和特异性可能限制结果的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study may not cover all potential body parameters and normalization methods, and the sample size and specificity of adolescent athletes may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: How Swing Tilt Translates into Batted-Ball Outcomes: Pitch-Type-Specific Mediation by Bat Speed in MLB
items.summary: This study examined how swing tilt influences batted-ball outcomes in MLB baseball, mediated by bat speed, in a pitch-type-specific manner.
items.curatedReason: 理解棒球运动员挥杆倾斜度如何转化为击球结果，可作为评估运动表现和设计训练干预措施的参考，尤其是通过提升挥棒速度来改善击球表现。
items.titleZh: 挥杆倾斜度如何转化为击球结果：MLB 中挥棒速度对特定投球类型的中介作用
items.summaryZh: 这项研究分析了 MLB 棒球运动员的挥杆倾斜度如何通过挥棒速度中介，在不同投球类型下影响击球结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding how swing tilt translates into batted-ball outcomes can inform the assessment of athletic performance and design of training interventions, particularly by leveraging bat speed to improve hitting.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于 MLB 棒球运动员，外推至其他运动项目或人群需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to MLB baseball players, and its findings may not be generalizable to other sports or populations.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Immediate task-specific and delayed generalized adaptations to variable dual-task training in community-dwelling older adults: a randomized waitlist-controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized waitlist-controlled trial (n=50) found that 12 weeks of variable dual-task training led to immediate improvements in functional lower-limb strength (SMD = 0.54) in older adults, sustained at 3-month follow-up. Delayed improvements in functional mobility, inhibitory control, and short-term memory emerged at follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，变异双任务训练能即时改善社区老年人的下肢功能性力量，并延迟改善功能性活动能力、抑制控制和短期记忆。你可以考虑将这种变异双任务训练纳入老年患者的康复方案，尤其是在追求长期认知和运动益处时。
items.titleZh: 社区老年人变异双任务训练的即时任务特异性与延迟泛化适应：一项随机候补对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机候补对照试验（n=50）发现，12周的变异双任务训练能即时改善老年人的下肢功能性力量（SMD = 0.54），并在3个月随访中维持。功能性活动能力、抑制控制和短期记忆的延迟改善在随访时出现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that variable dual-task training immediately improves functional lower-limb strength in community-dwelling older adults, with delayed improvements in functional mobility, inhibitory control, and short-term memory. You can consider incorporating this variable dual-task training into rehabilitation programs for older patients, especially when aiming for long-term cognitive and motor benefits.
items.limitation: 该研究的局限性在于其回顾性注册试验，且部分认知和运动益处表现为延迟效应，需要进一步研究其机制。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of this study is its retrospectively registered trial, and some cognitive and motor benefits appeared as delayed effects, requiring further research into their mechanisms.

items.title: Sex-Equitable Machine Learning Prediction of Ankle Reinjury in Individuals with Chronic Ankle Instability: A 2-Year Prospective Cohort Study with Fairness Audit
items.summary: A 2-year prospective cohort study developed and internally validated sex-equitable machine learning models to predict ankle reinjury in 96 individuals with chronic ankle instability. The Elastic Net model achieved an AUC of 0.807, and applying sex-specific decision thresholds reduced the equalized-odds gap by 57% (to 0.164).
items.curatedReason: 这款机器学习模型能预测慢性踝关节不稳患者的两年内再受伤风险，并引入性别公平的阈值策略，将性别平等的赔率差距减少了57%。这提示你，未来在临床应用预测模型时，应考虑性别特异性调整，以优化不同性别的患者管理。
items.titleZh: 慢性踝关节不稳患者踝关节再损伤的性别公平机器学习预测：一项为期两年的前瞻性队列研究及公平性审计
items.summaryZh: 一项为期两年的前瞻性队列研究开发并内部验证了性别公平的机器学习模型，以预测96名慢性踝关节不稳患者的踝关节再损伤。Elastic Net模型达到了0.807的AUC，并且应用性别特异性决策阈值将性别平等的赔率差距降低了57%（至0.164）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This machine learning model predicts the 2-year re-injury risk in individuals with chronic ankle instability and, with a sex-equitable threshold strategy, reduced the equalized-odds gap by 57%. This suggests that when applying predictive models in clinical practice, you should consider sex-specific adjustments to optimize patient management across genders.
items.limitation: 该研究的局限性在于其模型需要外部验证才能在临床中部署，且尽管通过性别特定阈值降低了性别公平差距，但"不成比例影响比"仍低于理想基准。
items.limitationEn: The study's limitation is that its model requires external validation before clinical deployment, and despite reducing the equalized-odds gap through sex-specific thresholding, the disproportionate-impact ratio remained below the ideal benchmark.

items.title: Prevalence and symptom severity of thrower’s shoulder in elite youth handball players
items.summary: A prospective study of 660 elite youth handball players (52.3% boys) found that 22.4% reported shoulder problems, with an average symptom severity of 457.8 ± 352.0 points on the WOSI questionnaire. Latent class analysis showed no discernible pattern of symptom distribution.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了精英青少年手球运动员肩部过度使用症状的流行率和症状严重程度。在预防和干预青少年运动员的肩部损伤方面，可以利用 WOSI 问卷来评估症状严重程度，但要避免将其作为区分症状模式的工具。
items.titleZh: 精英青少年手球运动员投掷肩部过度使用症状的流行率与严重程度
items.summaryZh: 一项针对660名精英青少年手球运动员（52.3%为男孩）的前瞻性研究发现，22.4%的运动员报告有肩部问题，WOSI问卷的平均症状严重度为457.8 ± 352.0分。潜在类别分析未能发现明显的症状分布模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals the prevalence and severity of overuse shoulder symptoms in elite youth handball players. In preventing and intervening shoulder injuries in young athletes, the WOSI questionnaire can be utilized to assess symptom severity, but should not be relied upon to differentiate symptom patterns.
items.limitation: 本研究的局限在于其观察性设计，未能探究症状的因果关系，且WOSI问卷未能识别出不同的症状模式。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of this study lies in its observational design, which did not explore the causal relationship of symptoms, and the WOSI questionnaire failed to identify distinct symptom patterns.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The development and psychometric evaluation of the Post Activity Symptom Scale (PASS) for Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/ Chronic Fatigue Syndrome.
items.summary: The Post Activity Symptom Scale (PASS) was developed and psychometrically evaluated, demonstrating moderate criterion-related validity (r=0.58, p<0.001), excellent discriminant validity (p<0.001), and test-retest reliability (ICC = 0.81) for measuring post-exertional malaise in ME/CFS patients.
items.curatedReason: PASS 量表为肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征患者的劳力后不适提供了一个有效、可靠且敏感的测量工具。这能让你更客观地追踪患者的症状变化，支持临床决策。
items.titleZh: 用于肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征的劳力后症状量表（PASS）的开发与心理测量学评估
items.summaryZh: 劳力后症状量表（PASS）的开发与心理测量学评估显示，该量表在测量肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征（ME/CFS）患者的劳力后不适方面具有中等准则效度（r=0.58, p<0.001）、优秀判别效度（p<0.001）和重测信度（ICC = 0.81）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The PASS scale offers a valid, reliable, and sensitive measure of post-exertional malaise in patients with Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome. This allows for more objective tracking of symptom changes and supports clinical decision-making.
items.limitation: 本研究为量表开发和心理测量学评估，仍需在更广泛的临床实践中验证其适用性。
items.limitationEn: This study focuses on scale development and psychometric evaluation; its applicability requires further validation in broader clinical practice.

items.title: Timed Up and Go, gait speed, and grip strength: associations and discriminative performance for falls in community-dwelling older adults - results from the KORA-age study
items.summary: A cohort study (n=1079) found that Timed Up and Go (TUG) performance was associated with reported falls in community-dwelling older adults (OR 1.095, 95% CI 1.018–1.176). However, TUG, gait speed, and grip strength showed no clear incremental discrimination beyond age and sex in identifying fallers, and established TUG thresholds had limited sensitivity.
items.curatedReason: 尽管 TUG 测试与跌倒风险相关，但它、步速和握力在区分有无跌倒史的老年人方面，增量判别能力有限。你在临床筛查时，应认识到这些测试的局限性，并综合其他风险因素考量。
items.titleZh: Timed Up and Go、步速和握力：社区老年人跌倒关联性与判别性能—KORA-age 研究结果
items.summaryZh: 一项队列研究（n=1079）发现，Timed Up and Go（TUG）表现与社区老年人报告的跌倒相关（OR 1.095，95% CI 1.018–1.176）。然而，TUG、步速和握力在区分跌倒者时，其超越年龄和性别的增量判别能力不明显，且既定的 TUG 阈值敏感性有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: While TUG is associated with falls, its incremental discriminative performance, along with gait speed and grip strength, for identifying older adults with or without falls is limited. When conducting clinical screenings, recognize the limitations of these tests and consider other risk factors.
items.limitation: 本研究数据基于自我报告的跌倒史，可能存在回忆偏倚，且为观察性研究。
items.limitationEn: This study relied on self-reported fall history, which may introduce recall bias, and is an observational study.

items.title: Comparison of robot-assisted gait training and visual feedback balance training on balance and gait outcomes in patients with stroke: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=50) comparing robot-assisted gait training (RoboGait) and visual feedback balance training (ProKin-252) for stroke patients found both improved balance and functional outcomes. ProKin-252 resulted in significantly greater improvements in Berg Balance Scale (1.43 points, 95% CI 0.37-2.49; p=.009) and fear of falling.
items.curatedReason: 在卒中患者的平衡和步态康复中，视觉反馈平衡训练在改善 Berg 平衡量表分数和减少跌倒恐惧方面略优于机器人辅助步态训练。虽然整体功能改善相似，但这个细节提示你可以考虑将视觉反馈训练作为更针对平衡和跌倒恐惧的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态训练与视觉反馈平衡训练对卒中患者平衡和步态结局的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=50）比较了卒中患者的机器人辅助步态训练（RoboGait）与视觉反馈平衡训练（ProKin-252），发现两者均能改善平衡和功能结局。ProKin-252 在 Berg 平衡量表（1.43 分，95% CI 0.37-2.49；p=.009）和跌倒恐惧方面显示出显著更大的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke patients' balance and gait rehabilitation, visual feedback balance training shows a slight advantage over robot-assisted gait training in improving Berg Balance Scale scores and reducing fear of falling. While overall functional improvements are similar, this detail suggests you might consider visual feedback training as a supplementary tool more specifically targeting balance and fear of falling.
items.limitation: 本研究虽然显示视觉反馈训练在某些平衡指标上略优，但其在 Berg 平衡量表上的调整后组间差异（1.43 分）可能不具有临床最小重要差异。
items.limitationEn: Although this study showed slight superiority of visual feedback training in some balance measures, the adjusted between-group difference on the Berg Balance Scale (1.43 points) might not meet the minimum clinically important difference.

items.title: Trump Administration Announces $10 Billion in Second Year of Rural Health Transformation Awards to All 50 States
items.summary: The Trump Administration has announced rural health transformation awards to all 50 states for the second consecutive year.

items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布，将连续第二年向美国全部 50 个州发放农村医疗转型奖励。

items.title: Effects of adjunctive craniosacral therapy to conventional physiotherapy on postural responses and autonomic function in individuals with multiple sclerosis: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=30) found that adding craniosacral therapy to conventional physiotherapy for MS patients led to greater reductions in Adaptation Test (toes-down) and Motor Control Test (back-small) latency measures over time (p=.034; p=.006), but no significant between-group differences in overall postural control or autonomic function.
items.curatedReason: 颅骶治疗作为多发性硬化症患者常规物理治疗的辅助手段，可能在改善特定姿势反应参数上发挥作用，但其对整体平衡和自主神经功能的影响尚不明确。在你评估辅助疗法时，应将此结果作为初步证据考虑，但切勿夸大其疗效。
items.titleZh: 辅助颅骶治疗联合常规物理治疗对多发性硬化症患者姿势反应和自主神经功能影响的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=30）发现，对多发性硬化症患者，在常规物理治疗中加入颅骶治疗能随时间显著减少适应测试（脚尖向下）和运动控制测试（后小）的潜伏期（p=.034；p=.006），但在整体姿势控制或自主神经功能方面未观察到显著的组间差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Craniosacral Therapy, as an adjunct to conventional physiotherapy for multiple sclerosis patients, may influence specific postural response parameters, but its overall impact on balance and autonomic function remains unclear. When evaluating adjunctive therapies, consider these results as preliminary evidence but avoid overstating efficacy.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（n=30），且虽然发现了组间交互作用，但未观察到显著的组间差异，提示效果可能有限或需要更大样本验证。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (n=30), and while group x time interactions were found, no significant between-group differences were observed, suggesting limited effects or the need for larger sample validation.

items.title: Regression-Based Balance Discordance Refines Prediction of Prospective Falls After Subacute Stroke: A Secondary Analysis of the LEAPS Trial
items.summary: A secondary analysis (n=384) of the LEAPS trial found that continuous, regression-based multivariable balance discordance (HR = 1.27, 95% CI 1.03-1.58, p = .026) predicted prospective, recurrent falls after subacute stroke, whereas previously published threshold-based classifications did not. Overconfidence relative to combined objective function was a more specific marker of fall risk.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，回归分析得出的平衡失调连续指标，特别是相对于客观功能的过度自信，能更好地预测亚急性卒中后的复发性跌倒风险。这意味着你在评估卒中患者跌倒风险时，应更精细地结合患者自评与客观功能数据，而非仅仅依赖阈值判断。
items.titleZh: 基于回归的平衡失调指标在预测亚急性卒中后前瞻性跌倒中的作用：LEAPS 试验的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 对 LEAPS 试验的二次分析（n=384）发现，连续的、基于回归的多变量平衡失调指标（HR = 1.27, 95% CI 1.03-1.58, p = .026）能预测亚急性卒中后的前瞻性复发性跌倒，而之前发布的基于阈值的分类则不能。相对于结合客观功能的过度自信是跌倒风险更具体的标志。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that continuous, regression-based measures of balance discordance, particularly overconfidence relative to objective function, better predict recurrent falls after subacute stroke. This means that when assessing fall risk in stroke patients, you should integrate patient self-reported data with objective functional data more finely, rather than relying solely on threshold-based judgments.
items.limitation: 本研究为一项随机对照试验的二次观察性分析，其结果的因果推断能力弱于前瞻性研究，且跌倒数据依赖患者自报。
items.limitationEn: This study is a secondary observational analysis of a randomized controlled trial, limiting its causal inference compared to prospective studies, and fall data relied on self-report.

items.title: Can traditional Chinese exercises help people with musculoskeletal disorders? - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: An umbrella review of 92 meta-analyses (1,744 trials) found high-certainty evidence that Traditional Chinese Exercises (TCEs) improved physical function and mental health in knee osteoarthritis, mental health in neck pain, and sleep quality in fibromyalgia. Tai Chi reduced chronic MSD-related pain and stiffness and increased bone mineral density in osteopenia/osteoporosis.
items.curatedReason: 传统中医运动对多种肌肉骨骼疾病（如膝骨关节炎、颈痛、纤维肌痛、骨质疏松和慢性踝关节不稳）具有高确定性或中等确定性证据支持其改善身体功能、心理健康和疼痛。这将支持您在临床实践中，将太极拳、八段锦、气功等传统中医运动作为常规治疗的补充，但需根据患者情况选择合适的运动类型和剂量。
items.titleZh: 传统中医运动能否帮助肌肉骨骼疾病患者？——BJSM 博客
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 92 项 Meta 分析（涵盖 1,744 项试验）的伞形综述发现，有高确定性证据表明传统中医运动（TCEs）能改善膝骨关节炎患者的身体功能和心理健康，颈痛患者的心理健康，以及纤维肌痛患者的睡眠质量。太极拳还可减轻慢性肌肉骨骼相关疼痛和僵硬，并增加骨质减少/骨质疏松患者的骨密度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Traditional Chinese exercises have high or moderate certainty evidence supporting their efficacy in improving physical function, mental health, and pain for various musculoskeletal disorders (e.g., knee OA, neck pain, fibromyalgia, osteoporosis, chronic ankle instability). This supports integrating Tai Chi, Baduanjin, and Qigong into your clinical practice as a complement to usual care, tailored to patient diagnosis and symptoms.
items.limitation: 本综述发现不同传统中医运动、不同肌肉骨骼疾病和不同健康结局之间的证据强度存在差异，提示临床应用时需注意个体化选择和评估。
items.limitationEn: This review found varying strengths of evidence across different Traditional Chinese Exercises, MSDs, and health outcomes, suggesting the need for individualized selection and assessment in clinical application.

items.title: Effects of sleep manipulation on athletic performance, cognitive function, and recovery: a systematic review of experimental studies
items.summary: A systematic review of 15 experimental studies found that sleep extension generally led to enhanced athletic performance (e.g., +9.5 m in shuttle run, -0.7 s in sprint time, ~3% improvement in endurance), cognitive function, and recovery. Sleep restriction had adverse effects, while daytime napping showed mixed, context-dependent results.
items.curatedReason: 睡眠延长普遍与运动员体能、认知功能和恢复的改善相关（如短跑时间缩短 0.7 秒，耐力提高 3%）。相反，睡眠限制则会产生负面影响。这坐实了睡眠干预在运动康复和表现提升中的重要性，您应将睡眠卫生作为运动员整体康复计划的核心组成部分。
items.titleZh: 睡眠干预对运动表现、认知功能和恢复的影响：一项实验研究的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 15 项实验研究的系统综述发现，睡眠延长通常能改善运动表现（例如，折返跑距离增加 9.5 米，短跑时间缩短 0.7 秒，耐力提高约 3%）、认知功能和恢复。睡眠限制则有负面影响，而白天小睡的结果则复杂且具有情境依赖性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Sleep extension is generally associated with improved athletic performance, cognitive function, and recovery (e.g., 0.7s reduction in sprint time, 3% increase in endurance), while sleep restriction has adverse effects. This confirms the importance of sleep interventions in sports rehabilitation and performance enhancement; you should integrate sleep hygiene as a core component of athletes' overall rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 本系统综述因纳入研究的设计和测量方法存在差异，采取叙述性综合而非 Meta 分析，可能影响效应量精确估计。
items.limitationEn: Due to variability in study designs and measures, this systematic review utilized a structured narrative synthesis rather than a meta-analysis, which may affect the precise estimation of effect sizes.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Comparison of the effects of modified razor curl and nordic hamstring exercises on hamstring muscle strength and posterior-chain endurance in male football players
items.summary: A 6-week RCT (n=45 male football players) found that both modified razor curl and Nordic hamstring exercise protocols significantly improved eccentric hamstring strength and trunk-hip extensor endurance (all p < 0.001) compared to a control group, with no significant difference in bilateral strength. MRCE may represent a practical alternative to NHE.
items.curatedReason: 修正剃刀卷（MRCE）与北欧腘绳肌练习（NHE）均能有效提升男足球运动员的腘绳肌离心力量和躯干-髋伸肌耐力。MRCE 可作为 NHE 的实用替代方案，并且可能支持更大的训练量。这为您在足球运动员腘绳肌损伤预防和康复中提供了更多训练选择。
items.titleZh: 修正剃刀卷和北欧腘绳肌练习对男足球运动员腘绳肌力量和后链耐力的影响比较
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 6 周的随机对照试验（n=45 名男足球运动员）发现，与对照组相比，修正剃刀卷和北欧腘绳肌练习方案均显著提升了腘绳肌离心力量和躯干-髋伸肌耐力（所有 p < 0.001），而双侧力量差异无显著变化。修正剃刀卷可能是北欧腘绳肌练习的实用替代方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both modified razor curl (MRCE) and Nordic hamstring exercises (NHE) are effective in improving eccentric hamstring strength and trunk-hip extensor endurance in male football players. MRCE can be a practical alternative to NHE and may allow for greater training volume, offering you more training options for hamstring injury prevention and rehabilitation in football players.
items.limitation: 本研究仅针对 18-23 岁的男性足球运动员，结果对外推至其他年龄段或性别的运动员需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study focused only on male football players aged 18–23 years, so results should be interpreted cautiously when extrapolating to other age groups or genders.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Severe injuries in competitive cycling during an olympic cycle: injury patterns, time loss, and return-to-performance outcomes
items.summary: A retrospective study of 192 cyclists found 37.5% sustained at least one severe injury (≥3 weeks time loss) over five years. Upper (33.8%) and lower (27.8%) extremities were most affected, with hand and clavicle fractures being most common. Full return to pre-injury performance ranged from 85.7% after hand fractures to 28.6% after AC joint separations.
items.curatedReason: 竞技自行车运动中，严重损伤模式因项目和环境而异，手部骨折和锁骨骨折是最常见的。特别提示您，肩锁关节（ACJ）分离后尽管时间损失中等，但重返受伤前表现的比例很低（28.6%）。这强调了在康复中区分“重返运动”和“重返表现”的重要性。
items.titleZh: 一个奥运周期内竞技自行车运动中的严重损伤：损伤模式、时间损失和重返表现结果
items.summaryZh: 一项对 192 名自行车运动员进行的回顾性研究发现，在五年内有 37.5% 的运动员至少经历一次严重损伤（导致≥3周时间损失）。上肢（33.8%）和下肢（27.8%）是最常受累的部位，手部和锁骨骨折最常见。重返受伤前表现的比例从手部骨折后的 85.7% 到肩锁关节分离后的 28.6% 不等。
items.curatedReasonEn: In competitive cycling, severe injury patterns vary by discipline and setting, with hand and clavicle fractures being most common. Notably, after acromioclavicular (ACJ) joint separations, despite moderate time loss, full return to pre-injury performance was very low (28.6%). This underscores the importance of distinguishing "return to sport" from "return to performance" in rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性在线问卷调查，可能存在回忆偏倚和样本选择偏倚，且比较分析被认为是探索性的。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective online questionnaire study, which may be subject to recall and selection bias, and comparative analyses were considered exploratory.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Evaluation of markerless hand-tracking accuracy in VR application designed for hand range-of-motion measurement and rehabilitation
items.summary: A technical pilot evaluation comparing markerless hand-tracking accuracy in VR found Meta Quest's native tracking showed lower MAE in 23 of 24 static configurations and higher median tolerance-band coverage than MediaPipe for thumb-finger distance measurement. Meta Quest tracking appears more suitable for distance-based VR hand rehabilitation applications under tested conditions.
items.curatedReason: Meta Quest 原生手部追踪在测量基于距离的 VR 手部康复应用中比 MediaPipe 更准确，且误差更小。这为开发和实施 VR 康复系统提供了技术参考，但结果仅限于技术验证，还需进一步临床验证。
items.titleZh: 用于手部运动范围测量和康复的 VR 应用中无标记手部追踪准确性评估
items.summaryZh: 一项评估 VR 应用中无标记手部追踪准确性的技术试点研究发现，在拇指-手指距离测量方面，Meta Quest 的原生追踪在 24 种静态配置中的 23 种表现出更低的平均绝对误差（MAE）和更高的中位容许带覆盖率，优于 MediaPipe。Meta Quest 追踪在测试条件下似乎更适合基于距离的 VR 手部康复应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Meta Quest's native hand tracking demonstrated superior accuracy and lower error rates compared to MediaPipe for distance-based VR hand rehabilitation applications. This provides technical guidance for developing and implementing VR rehabilitation systems, though further clinical validation is needed as these findings represent technical validation only.
items.limitation: 本研究为技术性试点评估，核心比较仅涉及一名健康成年男性，且未进行临床验证，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study was a technical pilot assessment; the core comparison involved only one healthy adult male and lacked clinical validation, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Feasibility and Preliminary Effects of Oropharyngeal Alignment Exercise on Swallowing Function in Neurological Disorders with Restricted Mouth Opening: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A single-arm pilot study with 9 participants (7 stroke, 1 Parkinson's) found oropharyngeal alignment exercise feasible and well-tolerated, with most showing increased maximal mouth opening (6-13 mm) and statistically significant improvements in MASA, GUSS, and PAS scores, particularly for semisolid boluses.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究表明，口咽对齐训练在有吞咽困难和口部张开受限的神经系统疾病患者中是可行且耐受性良好的。如果你的患者也有类似症状，可以留意后续更大规模的对照试验。
items.titleZh: 口咽对齐训练对伴口张受限的神经系统疾病患者吞咽功能的可行性及初步效果：一项预试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对9名参与者（7名卒中，1名帕金森病）进行的单臂预试验发现，口咽对齐训练可行且耐受性良好，大多数参与者最大口张开度增加6-13毫米，MASA、GUSS和PAS评分统计学显著改善，尤其对半固体团块效果明显。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study indicates that oropharyngeal alignment exercise is feasible and well-tolerated in neurological patients with dysphagia and restricted mouth opening. If your patients present with similar symptoms, keep an eye on future larger-scale controlled trials.
items.limitation: 这是一项单臂先导研究，样本量小，且缺乏对照组，无法推断干预的因果效应。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-arm pilot study with a small sample size and no control group, preventing causal inference of the intervention's effects.

items.title: Five Days of Acute Intermittent Hypoxia Is Safe and Improves Somatic Motor Function in Persons with Multiple Sclerosis
items.summary: A randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled crossover trial (n=23 MS patients) found that 5 days of acute intermittent hypoxia (AIH) significantly increased ankle plantarflexion torque (beta = 8.74 Nm, p < 0.001) and 6-minute walk distance (beta = 10.14 m, p = 0.039) compared to Sham, with no serious adverse events.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照交叉试验显示，每日急性间歇性低氧（AIH）对多发性硬化症（MS）患者是安全且耐受的，并能显著改善踝关节跖屈力量和步行耐力。你可考虑将AIH作为增强MS患者神经可塑性和康复效果的辅助手段，特别是在结合特定任务步态训练时。
items.titleZh: 五天急性间歇性低氧对多发性硬化症患者安全且可改善躯体运动功能。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照交叉试验（n=23名MS患者）发现，与假治疗相比，为期5天的急性间歇性低氧（AIH）显著增加了踝关节跖屈扭矩（beta = 8.74 Nm, p < 0.001）和6分钟步行距离（beta = 10.14 m, p = 0.039），且未报告严重不良事件。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled crossover trial shows that daily acute intermittent hypoxia (AIH) is safe and well-tolerated in persons with multiple sclerosis (MS) and significantly improves ankle plantarflexion strength and walking endurance. You may consider AIH as an adjunct to enhance neuroplasticity and rehabilitation outcomes in MS patients, especially when combined with task-specific gait training.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（23名患者），且随访时间有限，长期效果尚待确认。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size (23 patients) and limited follow-up duration, with long-term effects yet to be confirmed.

items.title: Final 2027 Physician Fee Schedule Has Mixed Payment Impact for Physical Therapy
items.summary: APTA reports on CMS's final 2027 Physician Fee Schedule, noting a mixed impact for physical therapy. CMS reduced conversion factors, but secured yearly payment increases for top-billed PT codes for the next several years.
items.curatedReason: CMS 发布了2027年医师收费标准最终规则，对物理治疗师而言，虽然转换因子有所下调，但高频PT代码在未来几年将获得年度支付增长。你需要仔细研究具体代码的费率调整，以优化你的报销策略。
items.titleZh: 2027年医师收费标准最终规则对物理治疗的支付影响喜忧参半 | APTA。
items.summaryZh: APTA 报道了 CMS 发布的2027年医师收费标准最终规则，指出对物理治疗有喜忧参半的影响。CMS 下调了转换因子，但确保了未来几年高频物理治疗代码的年度支付增长。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released the final 2027 Physician Fee Schedule. For physical therapists, while conversion factors are reduced, top-billed PT codes will see annual payment increases over the next few years. You need to meticulously review the specific code adjustments to optimize your reimbursement strategy.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - CEO update to the RACS Surgical Leaders Forum
items.summary: Ahpra's CEO, Justin Untersteiner, addressed the RACS Surgical Leaders Forum, discussing how the growing health workforce (approaching one million registered practitioners) and evolving care delivery models, including AI, necessitate agile regulation. He emphasized vigilance against emerging risks, particularly conflicts of interest in commercial arrangements that may influence clinical decisions.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (Ahpra) 的 CEO 强调，随着监管专业人数接近百万，新兴商业模式和AI技术带来新的执业风险，尤其关注可能影响临床决策的利益冲突。作为在澳大利亚执业的PT，你应特别留意更新后的行为准则和监管机构对利益冲突的指导意见。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 - CEO 向 RACS 外科领导者论坛更新。
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（Ahpra）首席执行官 Justin Untersteiner 在 RACS 外科领导者论坛上发表讲话，讨论了随着医疗从业人员数量接近百万，新兴的医疗服务模式（包括人工智能）如何要求灵活的监管。他强调了对新兴风险的警惕，尤其是商业安排中可能影响临床决策的利益冲突。
items.curatedReasonEn: The CEO of the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) highlighted new practice risks from emerging business models and AI technology as the number of regulated professionals approaches one million, with a particular focus on conflicts of interest that could influence clinical decision-making. As a PT practicing in Australia, you should pay close attention to the updated codes of conduct and regulatory guidance on conflicts of interest.

items.title: Unpacking the Success: An Ecological Systems Perspective on Distance Running Performance in Ethiopia
items.summary: A mixed-methods study (n=145 Ethiopian distance runners) found that primary education level (OR=5.80), normal BMI (OR=2.85), and academy training (OR=2.40) were significant quantitative predictors of high performance. Qualitative themes highlighted hardship, community support, and the balance between tradition and modernization in training.
items.curatedReason: 想培养高水平长跑运动员，别只盯着生理指标。这项针对埃塞俄比亚跑者的观察研究提示，初等教育（OR=5.80）、正常BMI（OR=2.85）和学院训练（OR=2.40）是重要的表现预测因子。更重要的是，社区支持和社会经济背景等宏观因素可能同样关键。
items.titleZh: 剖析成功：从生态系统视角看埃塞俄比亚长跑表现 | Sports Medicine - Open。
items.summaryZh: 一项混合方法研究（n=145名埃塞俄比亚长跑运动员）发现，小学教育水平（OR=5.80）、正常BMI（OR=2.85）和学院训练（OR=2.40）是高水平表现的显著定量预测因子。定性主题强调了训练中的艰辛、社区支持以及传统与现代化的平衡。
items.curatedReasonEn: Don't just focus on physiological metrics for high-performance distance runners. This observational study on Ethiopian runners suggests primary education (OR=5.80), normal BMI (OR=2.85), and academy training (OR=2.40) are significant predictors. Crucially, macro factors like community support and socioeconomic background may be just as vital.
items.limitation: 研究采用混合方法，但量化部分为观察性，结果存在潜在混杂因素，且模型外推性需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study used a mixed-methods approach, but the quantitative section is observational, with potential confounders and limited generalizability of the models.

items.title: The MSK Playbook: Hamstring Strain Injuries - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: A BJSM blog post reviews hamstring strain injuries, which account for 24% of all professional football injuries, with recurrence rates exceeding 30%. The article explores injury mechanisms, biomechanics, imaging use, and rehab protocols, emphasizing the complex challenges in management.
items.curatedReason: 这篇指南性文章回顾了腘绳肌拉伤的损伤机制、成像应用和康复方案，强调了这种常见运动损伤的高复发率。它提醒你评估和管理腘绳肌拉伤需要全面考虑生物力学、神经学和心理社会因素。
items.titleZh: MSK 剧本：腘绳肌拉伤 - BJSM 博客 - 社交媒体领先的运动医学之声。
items.summaryZh: BJSM 博客文章回顾了腘绳肌拉伤，这种损伤占所有职业足球损伤的24%，复发率超过30%。文章探讨了损伤机制、生物力学、影像学应用和康复方案，强调了管理中的复杂挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This guidance article reviews hamstring strain injury mechanisms, imaging applications, and rehabilitation protocols, highlighting the high recurrence rate of this common sports injury. It reminds you that assessing and managing hamstring strains requires a holistic consideration of biomechanical, neurological, and psychosocial factors.
